# PrintGuard fixture — synthetic, hand-written (گام G.5.1)
#
# Standard-MIB half of the Canon iR MF device (same target as
# exporter_response_canon.txt):
#
#     GET /snmp?target=172.16.0.9&module=printer_std&auth=public_v2
#
# Not a capture; same caveats as exporter_response_sample.txt.
#
# Numbers are self-consistent so the expected adapter output can be written as literal
# numbers in the test, not recomputed:
#   sys_uptime 17280000 ticks ÷ 100 = 172800 s → "2d 00:00"
#   toner NPG-86 Black: 62/100 → 62 % → ok ; NPG-86 Cyan: 18/100 → 18 % → low
#   tray1: 500/700 → 71 % → medium ; tray2_* absent → cap 0 + level −9 → series skipped
#   cover_status 3 → one alert («درب پرینتر باز است», code 3) — mirrors the hp rule,
#   because printer_canon has no cover OID in our spec at all.
#   bro_total 12000 − bro_color 4000 = 8000 = bw_std = bro_bw
# TYPE sys_descr gauge
sys_descr{sys_descr="Canon imageRUNNER 2224"} 1
# TYPE sys_uptime gauge
sys_uptime 17280000
# TYPE model_mib gauge
model_mib{model_mib="imageRUNNER 2224"} 1
# TYPE serial_mib gauge
serial_mib{serial_mib="A01234567"} 1
# TYPE cover_status gauge
cover_status 3
# TYPE bro_total counter
bro_total 12000
# TYPE bro_color counter
bro_color 4000
# TYPE bw_std counter
bw_std 8000
# TYPE bro_bw counter
bro_bw 8000
# TYPE toner_name_1 gauge
toner_name_1{toner_name_1="NPG-86 Black"} 1
# TYPE toner_max_1 gauge
toner_max_1 100
# TYPE toner_remain_1 gauge
toner_remain_1 62
# TYPE toner_name_2 gauge
toner_name_2{toner_name_2="NPG-86 Cyan"} 1
# TYPE toner_max_2 gauge
toner_max_2 100
# TYPE toner_remain_2 gauge
toner_remain_2 18
# TYPE tray1_cap gauge
tray1_cap 700
# TYPE tray1_level gauge
tray1_level 500
# TYPE tray1_name gauge
tray1_name{tray1_name="Cassette 1"} 1
